questions.question: Satan rose up against Israel and stirred King David to do what?
When the LORD gave King David three punishments to choose from, which did David choose?

answers.text: To fall into the hand of the LORD
To fall into the hands of his enemies
To face three years of famine

questions.question: Ornan offered to give King David his threshing floor, oxen and wheat for free. Why did David insist on paying?

answers.text: He would not offer sacrifices that cost him nothing
He thought Ornan's oxen were too old to offer
He wanted the priests to bring the wood
